concepts.description: The Condition rule grammar: field, date, array, aggregate, all/any, if/then/else, true/false rules; Operator / DateOperator / ArrayOperator enums; Condition and Strict* types
check(rule, data, options) -> true or failure message: value/enum/pattern (re2js)/fuzzy/number comparisons, custom and generated errors, root-array rules
Array rules (arrayOperator + element condition, counts), aggregate sum/avg rules and their empty/avg-NULL semantics, filter -> orderBy -> skip -> take windows, orderRecords
The one operator table per field kind and target: getOperatorsForKind, getArrayOperators, getAggregateOperators, getValueShape, FieldKind, RuleTarget, unit sets
validateRule / assertValidRule per target with coded ValidationIssues, UsageError vs LensRefusal vs plain Error, error-message helpers
Date operators and relative/calendar DateExpr (ago/ahead, this/last/next, rolling, edges), explicit now, timeZone/weekStart, resolveDateConfig, clockUnit and clock.finestUnit
Where a compared value comes from: literal, { path } column compares, $. / $$. scope refs, offsets and unit amounts
{ bind } placeholders and bindOptional: bindRule, listBindings, listFields, check's bindings, and the lens forms bindLens / listLensBindings
Computed values: evaluateValue (literal/path/bind/count-sum-avg-min-max-distinct aggregates/if/list), coerceType, validateValue, describeValue, inferValueType, coerceValue, valueClockUnit
toPrisma(rule, { map, model, now }) -> { steps }: count/group steps, column refs, relation folding, Json AnyNull
executePrismaPlan(plan, delegate) and the WHERE composers andWhere / orWhere / matchAll / matchNothing
toSql(rule, options): parameterized PostgreSQL WHERE + LEFT JOINs, storage-aware arrays, Json, aggregates, quoting and params
toWhereSql / toLensWhereSql inline predicates in sql.dialect (postgres/mysql) over caller columns/tables, EXISTS / NOT EXISTS or toMany: 'join'
Negated and negative-flavored date operators keep NULL rows on every rail; isRequired: false licenses toPrisma's NULL and optional-hop arms
Which rail (check / toPrisma / toSql) compiles which rule shape, per-rail limitations, and where the rails legitimately differ
src/traverse.ts as the single condition-tree walk (visitCondition, someCondition, mapCondition, ConditionShape, getConditionShapeKeys) and own-property reads
docs/VERBS.md: one public name and one owning module per verb, enforced by test/verbs.test.ts; the root index.ts export list (no export *)
Standing rulings: the engine evaluates one rule, introspection lives in the lens, everything serializable, extend primitives not wrappers, bun run check / PGlite differential verification
engineGlobals process-wide defaults (string.caseInsensitive, string.fuzzy, prismaOptions, sql.dialect, clock.finestUnit), with(), registerEngineGlobals
FieldMap / FieldMapEntry / FieldMapSet schema description, Bridges and stitchFieldMaps, indexBridges, map:Model endpoint keys, field-path walks, validateFieldMaps
createLens and the shape of one LensNarrowing: picks/omits, enum narrowing, relations off until turned on, mapDefaults vs path-specific narrowing

How lens layers stack: where anchors and the filter-first all, layers only narrow, clamps read only what the parent shows, composition as intersection, clampLens / composeLens / storeLens, validateNarrowing, LensRefusal, policy.ts
Rules under a lens: validateRuleInLens gate, narrowRule (filter-first anchoring), { lens } compiles, describeRule, coerceRule
What a lens shows and fetches: projectLens by path / by model, lensVisit, walkLensPath, readLensValue, toLensSelect + projectRows
Field option sources: SourceSpec, toSourceQueries (Prisma + SQL, bridged over-fetch and recheck), materializeSourceQuery / materializeSources, SourceOptionOrder, describeRuleSources
